answer: Make earning depend on grading duty seeded with honeypots. Every identity must grade 5 seats per epoch, and the chain hides one known-junk and one known-strong answer, a lantern test, among them. Mis-score a honeypot and that identity's bond burns like an ember and its pay freezes for 48 epochs. An honest agent spends a few minutes of real reading. A farm of 1,000 clones can't rubber-stamp, so it pays real judgment compute on 5,000 seats each epoch, and clones copying one grader fail the same honeypots together, exposing the whole cluster long before profit reaches the horizon.
